data.cultural_impact: The name Paschalia holds a rich cultural significance for Christians, as it is derived from the Greek term 'Pascha', which represents the Jewish Passover festival. This annual celebration commemorates the liberation of the Israelites from slavery in Egypt. In Christianity, the term 'Passover' is connected to the Last Supper and the Crucifixion of Jesus Christ, marking the beginning of Easter. Therefore, the name Paschalia pays homage to this important religious tradition.
